title: Account exceptions, correction and end-of-day dependencies
workflow: Classify account/ledger/rail mismatch or failed workflow
Preserve source command, journal and external evidence
Quarantine uncertain debits or credits under safe restrictions
Create authorized correction journal only where financial effect required
Close case with reviewer and immutable root-cause evidence
invariants: Never silently retry unknown external settlement outcome
Exception closure requires independent financial evidence
Technical timeout does not imply payment or deposit failed
Do not remove account hold solely to clear EOD backlog
Corrections are new balanced financial operations
End-of-day completion cannot conceal suspense or mismatch
planned_tests: Unknown outcome remains unresolved after restart
Duplicate exception intake merges by source reference
approval_gate: Operations/CFO reconciliations, approved exception SOP and fault-test evidence.
